passive.name: Traveler's Call
passive.text: Meeps: Bard attracts lesser spirits that assist with his basic attacks to deal extra magic damage. When Bard has collected enough Chimes, his meeps will also deal damage in an area and slow enemies hit.Chimes: Ancient chimes randomly appear for Bard to collect. These grant experience, restore mana, and provide out of combat Move Speed.

spells.name: Cosmic Binding
spells.text: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both.

spells.name: Caretaker's Shrine
spells.text: Reveals a Health shrine which powers up over a short time, disappearing after healing and speeding up the first ally that touches it.

spells.name: Magical Journey
spells.text: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

spells.name: Tempered Fate
spells.text: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

damage.value: Bard deals sustained magic damage through meeps that assist his basic attacks.

axis.value: Bard can poke with Cosmic Binding, which slows the first enemy it hits.

spikes.why: Bard’s meeps begin dealing area damage and slowing enemies.

mistakes.value: Bard misses experience, mana restoration, and out-of-combat Move Speed when Bard neglects Chimes.
